sentence: 女っちゅうのはホンマ面倒くさいのう。
literal: Women really are a damn pain, huh.
official: Herdin' these women is gonna put me in the nut house.

sentence: すみません、お手数ですがお願いします。
literal: Sorry to trouble you, sir, but I'll leave it to you.
official: Sorry to trouble you with it, sir.

sentence: やっぱりそう簡単に一見の客にノゾミは来んか……
literal: Figures Nozomi won't come to a first-time customer that easily...
official: Figures they wouldn't waste Nozomi on a first-timer.

sentence: おぉ～、こらえらいべっぴんさんが来たなぁ！

sentence: アカン、俺は何を普通に話し込んでるんや……！

official: Ugh, why am I chattin' this girl up like a tool?
